carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the lateral midline of the caudal peduncle, characterized by high-luminance pixels on the dorsal aspect and a distinct shadow gradient on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular tissue loss and jagged truncation on the posterior-superior margin of the upper caudal fin lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated remora is attached to the ventral-lateral flank region anterior to the lower caudal lobe.
